name: Columbiana County, OH
findings: Columbiana County has 369 nonprofit organizations. 146 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 112 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Columbiana County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 15 hobby and sports organizations here list public events, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.
